title: Verify report (machine-checkable extract)
description: The units/<UID>/verify.json artifact (JSON-only; no verify.md). Encodes the executor<->verifier LOOP contract + the verifier-independence invariant + the premise-check (the independent COUNTER re-run). verdict/iteration/feedback/defects/socratic/premise_check are required. executor_reasoning_seen MUST be false (independence). FAIL is schema-INVALID unless it carries >=1 defect (each naming a criterion) AND feedback.actionable_changes is non-empty; PASS (I6 clause REVISED for coverage-first, PR1) requires NO blocker/major defect but MAY carry `minor` observations; DISAGREE requires a disagreement object. Optional PR1 fields: `panel[]` (odd-panel-of-3 with distinct correctness/reproduce/guardrail lenses; top verdict == discrete majority, no softmax), `verify_rounds`/`converged` (bounded loop-until-dry). The defect.criterion in brief.acceptance_criteria membership + the I16 panel discipline are cross-checked in validate_run.py.

executor_reasoning_seen.description: Independence invariant: the verifier saw brief+debrief+artifacts only, never the executor's chain-of-thought. MUST be false (maker!=checker). Self-attestation, not a platform guarantee (see state-machine Limitation A).

inputs_reviewed.description: OPTIONAL. What the verifier actually read. WIDENED (I42 / R18 / BB-L46, 1.11.0): an element may stay a bare path string, or become an evidence object carrying `path` (+ optional `sha256` content digest and `bytes`). A union WIDENING, not a contract revision — every previously-valid document stays valid and no key becomes required. validate_run.py I42 re-hashes run-dir-relative paths and FAILs on drift; out-of-run paths are an exit-neutral NOTE (not decidable from emitted artifacts). A digest proves the bytes match now, NOT that the verifier read them (Limitation Z).

audit_notes.description: Optional free-form record of the verifier's adversarial work (per-criterion independent check, evidence audit, hallucination sweep, budget check) that formerly lived in verify.md prose. Not required — the load-bearing outputs are verdict/feedback/defects/premise_check.

panel.description: OPTIONAL. When a unit is verified by an odd panel (>=3) of INDEPENDENT verifiers with DISTINCT lenses (PR1 verifier hardening), record each panelist here. The top-level `verdict` MUST equal the DISCRETE majority of the panel verdicts (no softmax); a split with no strict majority MUST route to DISAGREE (AO-5). Members must cover the canonical lens trio correctness/reproduce/guardrail (not 3 clones). REQUIRED by validate_run.py I16 on any unit tagged `high-stakes`. Node-internal: recording a panel adds no FSM edge (termination proof untouched).

lens.description: The panelist's distinct lens: correctness (criteria + evidence), reproduce (re-run/re-derive the result), guardrail (scope/non-goal/gold-plating compliance).

defects.description: OPTIONAL (I41, 1.11.0). This MEMBER's own findings, recorded at their HONEST severity — item shape identical to the top-level defects.items. Under I16 a 2-1 panel FORCES the majority verdict and I6 permits only `minor` on a PASS, so without this locus a dissenting lens' major had nowhere to live but prose. Recording it here is NOT an I6 violation: I6 is scoped to the TOP-LEVEL defects[] (covered by one layer only). validate_run.py I41-2/I41-3 require a dissenting member to carry one, and require a member blocker/major on a PASS to be named by a panel_adjudication disposition.

panel_adjudication.description: OPTIONAL (I41, 1.11.0). How a panel-level dissent was disposed of. Required by validate_run.py I41-1 on a run stamped >=1.11.0 whose verdict is PASS with >=1 dissenting panel member — the I16 artifact-contract REVISES (see references/formal-models.md). Adding a key here NEVER makes an archived verify invalid: nothing in this object is `required` at the document level. I41-4c forbids re-polling the lens that dissented (or any lens that had already tested the disputed finding) — re-running the dissenter until it flips is the AO-5 prohibition; a bounded re-poll of UNTESTED lenses rides the existing verify_rounds<=3 bound (I16-(c)), which I41 does not touch.

repoll.description: One row per lens re-polled. `tested_defect` records whether that lens had tested the disputed finding BEFORE the re-poll; true is illegal (I41-4c). panel[] holds the FINAL vote, so panel[lens].verdict must equal post_verdict (I41-4d).

verify_rounds.description: OPTIONAL. Number of loop-until-dry adversarial sweeps run INSIDE this single VERIFY node (defects accumulate across rounds until a round surfaces no NEW defect — 'dry' — or the R_max=3 cap is hit). Node-internal work that adds NO FSM edge; validate_run.py (I16) checks 1<=verify_rounds<=3 (finiteness). See references/self-learning-loops.md §2/§3.

converged.description: OPTIONAL. true iff the loop-until-dry sweep stopped because a round surfaced no NEW defect ('dry'); false iff it stopped at the R_max round cap (coverage may be incomplete — surface honestly).

feedback.description: Feedback object. actionable_changes = concrete edits for the next iteration (must be non-empty on FAIL); do_not_touch = what was correct and must be preserved.

defects.description: Top-level defect list. PASS => no blocker/major defect (minor observations allowed — I6 revised for coverage-first, PR1); FAIL => >=1, each citing a brief acceptance criterion (membership cross-checked by the validator).

socratic.description: The VERIFIER's own CANONICAL 4-key socratic block on its verdict. Same shape + rules as the debrief block.

horizon.description: I49 (1.14.0, Ask 1) — OPTIONAL fifth key, mirroring the debrief block. The four-key `required` list above is UNCHANGED.

allOf.$comment: I49-2 strict iff, forward half: debt REQUIRED when choice == expedient.
I49-2 strict iff, backward half: debt FORBIDDEN when choice == durable.

consequence.description: OPTIONAL. U08 RECORDING SLICE ONLY (1.14.0) — what this unit's findings turned out to DECIDE. NO PREDICATE READS THIS FIELD. The consequence-proportional-depth ESCALATION arm (I55) is DEFERRED: its published +4 sub-agents / ~76,000 tokens reproduces a CITATION proxy for the firing rate, while the STRUCTURAL proxy the design implies gives 11 of 14 units firing (+22 sub-agents, ~416,000 tokens — 89.8% of the whole bill), and the incident replay finds it would have made the motivating run WORSE, because its escalation triggers are exactly the profile of the shadow investigations that caused the drift. ADOPTION TRIGGER: write this field for one full run, convene nothing extra, then measure the real firing rate; if it lands near 2 of 14 rather than 11 of 14, lift the deferral — and fix the cross-iteration ordering defect first (d0 must join in the PREVIOUS iteration's panel size, or a unit that convened five lenses at iteration 1 and three at iteration 2 satisfies I55 exactly). The monotone join at the heart of that design was independently verified sound across 96 of 96 states; this is a deferral, not a refutation.

graph_effect.description: Did a finding here cause an amendment? Name it, or say it did not.

premise_check.description: Backstop against premise deflection (the independent COUNTER re-run): the verifier attests it first confirmed the executor's stated premise is the deliverable's LOAD-BEARING claim, then RE-RAN COUNTER on it independently (decoupled, from evidence, never by reading executor reasoning). Provides the field; the templates wire the prose.

disagreement.description: Present iff verdict==DISAGREE: why evidence cannot settle it (routes to Phase 7). The iff is now enforced BOTH directions (N-06/PR-6): the DISAGREE=>present clause plus the non-DISAGREE=>absent clause in allOf below.

retrieval_coverage.description: OPTIONAL (execution-effort enforcement, I30 - the I22 guardrail_compliance pattern). The verifier's RE-DERIVED comparison of debrief evidence AGAINST the brief's claims_owed/required_sources, plus the re-derivation probe records (U04 keys ratified verbatim: retrieval_probes[], retrieval_probes_none_reason, tier_at_verification - consumed by I28-P4/DT-K2). Adoption-closure: once any verdict-bearing verify carries it, all must; a brief carrying non-empty claims_owed/required_sources forces it on that unit's verify. owed_check must be TOTAL over the brief's owed ids (set equality); PASS with an uncovered owed id (or a not-consulted required source) is the I30 contradiction FAIL. covered-downgraded (parametric-only / vendor-silent coverage) is a verifier-visible confidence downgrade, legal on PASS, never silently relabeled covered (I30-2). tier_at_verification is required by I30-0 whenever fsm-state carries the depth block.

allOf.$comment: RT-1: covered/covered-downgraded REQUIRES >=1 counted row - empty row_refs can never count as coverage (the vacuous-pass hole). I30-2 carries the raw-parse mirror + the existential lattice reading.

guardrail_compliance.description: OPTIONAL (guardrail enforcement). Per-verify attestation rows, one per non-goal checked: `non_goal` MUST be a VERBATIM clarifications.json non_goals string. Adoption-closure (validate_run.py I22, offline post-hoc): once ANY verdict-bearing verify carries the block, EVERY verdict-bearing verify must; membership + coverage of the unit's non_goal_refs are mechanical; one decidable semantic clause — a `violated` row on a PASS verdict is a FAIL (a delivered non-goal is a FAIL, not a bonus). Whether a `respected` row is TRUE stays verifier attestation (presence-not-genuineness).

consequential_verbatim_check.description: VR-1/AF-19: OPTIONAL whole-run verify field — the consequential prompt-verbatim enumeration the whole-run verify.json spot-checks. One row per consequential register item: its register_id plus a non-blank outcome. Absent => valid.

case_set_audit.description: OPTIONAL at the schema level, REQUIRED offline (case_set contract SPEC.md section 6.2) on every verdict-bearing AGGREGATED verify.json for a unit whose brief carries the high-stakes tag - a schema cannot read the sibling brief's tags, so the trigger is adjudicated post-hoc. Per-member verify_p<N>.json files MUST NOT carry it: the lens holder supplies the values, the aggregator writes them. This object records MECHANISM STATE only. It is NOT the findings channel - every case-set adequacy finding goes into the existing defects[] (section 6.1), because I6's blocker-on-PASS rule reads defects[] and a finding recorded anywhere else is invisible to it.

commitment_sha256.description: The hash cited from the frozen derivation (section 7). 64 zeros => no derivation exists, which on a high-stakes unit is a hard FAIL carried with commitment_match:false - omission is louder than compliance.

commitment_iteration.description: The iteration in which the commitment was FIRST written; cited unchanged forever. It detects what the hash cannot: a legitimately identical set re-derived at a later iteration leaves commitment_sha256 unchanged while this advances.

commitment_match.description: true iff the recomputed hash equals the cited one. false is a hard FAIL (DoD 3b), never a NOTE.

discharge_check.description: The section-3.3 adjudication; all four fields REQUIRED ([] when empty). Any non-empty list is a FAIL. Brief-side case_set[].id uniqueness is a PRECONDITION of the tier floor, not a fifth field - the four-field shape is unchanged.

missing_ids.description: ids in the frozen brief.case_set with NO origin:'orchestrator' row (shrink).

extra_ids.description: origin:'orchestrator' rows whose id is not in the frozen brief.case_set. Executor ADDs are origin:'executor' and are NEVER counted here - counting them would FAIL the exact behaviour Non-Goal 3 protects.

duplicate_ids.description: ids appearing in more than one origin:'orchestrator' row.

tier_shortfall_ids.description: ids whose row evidence_tier is below floor(row), where floor(row) := FLOOR[row.check_form] when origin:'executor' and FLOOR[brief.case_set[row.id].check_form] when origin:'orchestrator' (FLOOR = {command: executable, locator: located}). Defined over rows of BOTH origins; the id-resolution guard scopes the orchestrator BRANCH of floor(), not the field's domain. Evaluation order is NORMATIVE: extra_ids and the brief-side id-uniqueness precondition are computed FIRST, so a dangling id lands in extra_ids and never reaches floor().

novelty_rate.description: DoD 3d. Recorded per run so a persistently zero reading exposes the step as redundant or as theater. A single zero reading is NOT itself a FAIL.

vocabulary_containment.description: DoD 3c. Identifiers appearing in the derived set that exist only in the executor's artifact are positive evidence of contamination. Advisory NOTE only - never a FAIL.

blast_audit.description: OPTIONAL at the schema level; written on the AGGREGATED verify.json only (per-member verify_p<N>.json files do not carry it) by the existing guardrail lens, which audits the unit's blast-radius obligations - no extra verifier dispatch and no extra lens. impact_sha256 cites the units/<UID>/impact.json the rows adjudicate (equal to its .sha256 sidecar). One row per impact obligation: `exercised` = a check that reaches the obligation was run (check, exit_code, and the red_input under which it fails, all required); `unaffected` = the change cannot reach it (rationale required); `owned_by` = another unit's frame owns it (owner_unit required); `broken` = the change breaks it (rationale required) - a finding that also belongs in defects[]. The per-disposition requirements below are the first line of defence; the validator re-checks coverage, citation and owner offline.

allOf.description: disagreement present IFF verdict==DISAGREE — the => direction (N-06/PR-6): a non-DISAGREE verdict (PASS or FAIL) MUST NOT carry a disagreement object. The <= direction (DISAGREE=>present) is the dedicated clause further below. Uses `not` (built-in mini-validator extended for this — jsonschema supports it natively), so both backends agree.
FAIL => >=1 defect AND non-empty feedback.actionable_changes (evidence-bound critique).

PASS => no blocker/major defect (I6 PASS-clause, REVISED for coverage-first, PR1). Was `defects==[]`; now a PASS MAY carry `minor` observations (report every finding + severity, filter downstream) but MUST NOT carry a blocker/major defect — a blocking defect is incompatible with acceptance. A PASS with defects==[] still validates (backward-compatible). See references/self-learning-loops.md §5 (I6 revision + do_not_touch/AO-2 interplay) and references/state-machine.md I6.
DISAGREE => a disagreement object is present AND complete (why_unresolvable set) (routes to the Phase-7 gate).
